description: This is a Python source file implementing tenant context management, authorization enforcement, and audit logging for a multi-tenant application. It includes classes and functions for extracting tenant info from request headers and JWTs, enforcing tenant access, and logging audit events to MongoDB.

classes.name: TenantContext
classes.description: Holds request-scoped tenant and user metadata including tenant ID, user ID, email, roles, and JWT subject.

classes.name: AuditEvent
classes.description: Represents a single audit log entry, including tenant ID, actor info, action, target, metadata, and timestamp.

methods.name: TenantContext get_tenant_context( request: Request, x_tenant_id: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias=None), authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None), )
methods.description: Resolves the tenant context from request headers and JWT, extracting necessary claims and handling fallback logic.

methods.name: None enforce_tenant_match(ctx: TenantContext, claimed_tenant_id: str)
methods.description: Ensures that the provided tenant ID matches the tenant in the current context; raises 403 if not.

methods.name: None authorize_connection_access(ctx: TenantContext, connection_id: str)
methods.description: Verifies access to a specific connection; placeholder for RBAC logic based on tenant and connection ID.

methods.name: None write_audit_event(ctx: TenantContext, event: AuditEvent)
methods.description: Persists an audit event to the database asynchronously; failures are swallowed to avoid blocking.
